Method of Attack: Exploitation of CVE-2019-19781 vulnerability allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution via Directory Traversal
Remote reading of sensitive credential config files using ../ directory traversal
Impacted Systems: Citrix ADC and Citrix Gateway version 13.0 all supported builds
Citrix ADC and NetScaler Gateway version 12.1 all supported builds
Citrix ADC and NetScaler Gateway version 12.0 all supported builds
Citrix ADC and NetScaler Gateway version 11.1 all supported builds
Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway version 10.5 all supported builds
Attack Vector: Network perimeter exposure of Citrix applications
Directory Traversal via web requests containing '/../vpns/' or '/vpns/cfg/smb.conf'
Indicators of Compromise: Twitter post by Kevin Beaumont (@GossiTheDog) with URL https://t.co/pDZ2lplSBj
